usedFor: Shopify holds the store and HeyStream hosts webinars and broadcasts, so “New Product” can open a session through “Create Broadcast”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Broadcast” in HeyStream
bestTemplate.why: A new product is worth a live demo, and the action creates the broadcast in HeyStream.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Register Contact for Broadcast” built on it runs after a scheduled check.
